name: Materials
label: Material
title: Natural materials
description: The colours a room brings with it: wood, stone, clay, plaster, fibre, metal, and the living things and sky around a house. A material is never one colour, so each is a range: light, typical and dark. Palettes are chosen to live with these, and exteriors start here.
data: Studio estimates of typical colour ranges, not measurements
note: Values are studio estimates of typical finishes under neutral daylight, to be replaced by measurements from real photographs. Real materials vary from piece to piece, with finish, and with age.

materials.name: White oak
materials.texture: Open, straight grain with flecks of ray
materials.ages: Ambers and deepens slightly in sun

materials.name: Walnut
materials.texture: Fine, wavy grain; chocolate with purple-grey streaks
materials.ages: Lightens and warms towards honey-brown in sun

materials.name: Ash
materials.texture: Pale, strong grain, close to oak but cleaner
materials.ages: Yellows gently

materials.name: Pine
materials.ages: Turns orange-yellow quickly unless treated

materials.name: Teak
materials.ages: Weathers to silver-grey outdoors if left unoiled

materials.name: Cherry
materials.texture: Smooth, fine grain, pinkish when new
materials.ages: Darkens markedly to red-brown within months

materials.name: Weathered timber
materials.ages: Already aged: silver-grey from sun and rain

materials.name: Cedar cladding
materials.ages: Silvers within a year or two unless sealed

materials.name: Limestone
materials.ages: Softens and darkens slightly where touched

materials.name: Travertine
materials.ages: Holes fill and edges soften with wear

materials.name: Carrara marble
materials.texture: White ground with soft grey veining
materials.ages: Etches and dulls where acids touch it

materials.name: Slate
materials.ages: Lightens and dulls when dry; darkens when wet

materials.name: Grey granite
materials.ages: Barely changes

materials.name: Sandstone
materials.ages: Weathers darker and greener outdoors

materials.name: Terracotta tile
materials.ages: Patinas and darkens with sealing and use

materials.name: Red brick

materials.name: Yellow stock brick

materials.name: Glazed tile, white

materials.name: Lime plaster
materials.ages: Mellows; picks up a faint warmth

materials.name: Clay plaster

materials.name: Board-marked concrete

materials.name: Lime render

materials.name: Linen, natural

materials.name: Wool, undyed
materials.ages: Yellows a little with age

materials.name: Rattan and cane
materials.ages: Deepens to honey-brown

materials.name: Jute and sisal
materials.ages: Fades and frays at edges

materials.name: Tan leather
materials.ages: Darkens and polishes where used

materials.name: Cotton canvas, undyed
